triage_scope: fresh defect-only triage of the current-boundary PR observation finding

finding.observation: The Candidate validator checks PlantUML framing and role coverage but does not execute a PlantUML parser against every fenced block.
finding.reason: The approved Requirement, Design, and Plan assign runtime validation to deterministic structural completeness and assign the pinned PlantUML 1.2026.6 syntax check to S12 acceptance/review outside the shipped Runtime. The current 6a31f1bc commit is evidence/report-only and does not introduce the validator behavior. Moving syntax execution into Candidate creation would change the approved ownership and dependency boundary.
deterministic_evidence: requirement.md:300-308, 336-337 separates runtime completeness from PlantUML 1.2026.6 acceptance and assigns invalid-PlantUML detection to fresh defect-only review
design.md:292-304 keeps a PlantUML executable out of the shipped Runtime and places syntax checking in the test/acceptance toolchain
plan.md:740-759 assigns structural Candidate validation to S10 and extracted-diagram PlantUML acceptance to S12
issue_planning_candidate.py:140-193 implements the structural boundary and deliberately does not parse PlantUML grammar
provider and dogfood projection blobs match

impact.actual: A structurally complete future guide could contain statement-level-invalid PlantUML that the runtime function alone would not reject.
impact.contractual_assessment: This residual risk is covered by the designated acceptance/review toolchain and current-guide evidence; it is not a missing production Candidate gate.
impact.merge_effect: Do not block PR #351 or change provider/runtime dependencies for this observation.

prohibited_scope_expansion: PlantUML executable or parser dependency in shipped Runtime
new service or public schema/reason mapping

minimum_tests.optional_follow_up: A later acceptance-only negative fixture may prove that the pinned checker rejects a correctly framed malformed diagram, while remaining outside provider and dogfood Runtime surfaces.

uncertainty: ChatGPT did not independently execute PlantUML 1.2026.6 against the illustrative malformed fixture in this read-only triage.
That parser execution uncertainty does not alter the verdict because the approved ownership boundary still places the check outside the production Candidate validator.
